description: Create a prepared version of a project. The live publication stays unchanged. Takes file content only: no local paths and no ZIP archives. Send a large site across several calls with complete set to false.

complete.description: Set false to keep the upload open for more files in later calls.

deletePaths.description: Paths to remove. Only with patch, on the completing call.

entrypoint.description: The file served at the site's root, set on the completing call. Defaults to the root index.html or the only file; patch keeps the current one.

files.description: Use text for text files and base64 for binary files.

mode.description: Required on the completing call if the project has a version. replace makes the sent files the whole site; patch adds or replaces the sent files and keeps the others of the online version.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

uploadContinuationId.description: From an earlier call with complete false. Continues that upload.

name: upload

previewLink.description: Where the user can check and publish the version. null while the upload is open.

uploadContinuationId.description: Present while the upload is open.

version.description: null while the upload is open.

title: Upload files
